prompt: If $x = 3$, what is the value of $x^2 + 2x$?

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Warm up with $x = 2$: $x^2 + 2x$ becomes $4 + 4 = 8$. Do the SAME two steps with $3$: square it, double it, then add.

alternativeExplanations.title: One piece at a time
steps: Break the expression into two pieces: $x^2$ and $2x$.
With $x = 3$: the first piece is 9, the second piece is 6.
Glue the pieces back with the plus sign: $9 + 6 = 15$.
